clips.title: The story
paras: At Orgrimmar's southern gate, timber and iron guard the entrance cut into northern Durotar's red rock. The passage leads from the arid wastes to the Valley of Strength, the capital's busy commons. The gate proclaims the Horde's endurance and strength in war.

Orgrimmar's main gate guards the great chasm cut into the mountains around the city. Towering wooden palisades, iron spikes, and watchtowers fortify the entrance. Travelers coming from Razor Hill and Durotar's scrublands find a grand welcome and a warning to any who threaten the new Horde. Armed Orgrimmar Grunts patrol the approach and watch everyone entering the city.

Beyond the gate's shadowed arch, you enter the Valley of Strength, Orgrimmar's civic and martial heart. The tunnel narrows the way for envoys, merchants, and warriors, with sentries watching those who pass. Here stands Warchief Thrall's dream of a secure refuge carved from the harsh desert, where the Horde's many peoples can walk together without fear.
